natural_language_prompt: I need to squeeze in some errands this week. Can you fit in: grocery shopping at Trader Joe's, picking up dry cleaning, and maybe a quick dinner at a restaurant between my 1:1s on Thursday and school pickup? Also need to hit the gym at some point in the evening.

tasks_to_add.title: Quick dinner out
tasks_to_add.preferred_time: between 1:1s and school pickup on Thursday
tasks_to_add.notes: Testing if agent realizes there's only 15min gap between events

feasibility_traps.description: Restaurant between 1:1s (ends 15:00) and pickup (starts 15:15) = only 15 minutes
feasibility_traps.expected_agent_behavior: Should recognize impossibility and suggest alternative

feasibility_traps.description: Evening gym after kids bedtime means starting at 20:30, but many gyms close at 21:00-22:00
feasibility_traps.expected_agent_behavior: Should check gym hours or note time constraint

feasibility_traps.description: Multiple errands require driving between locations
feasibility_traps.expected_agent_behavior: Should account for 10-15 min travel between each location

expected_challenges: Conflicting priorities (work vs family vs errands)
ground_truth_issues: Evening gym may conflict with facility hours
Dry cleaning pickup may be hard to fit during work hours
